description: This file implements an API for managing TR181 parameters, including functions for getting, setting, clearing, and handling parameters both locally and through external RFC mechanisms. It also includes logging and synchronization features, specifically designed for managing device configuration parameters in a network device.

methods.name: TR181_PARAM_TYPE getType(DATA_TYPE type)
methods.description: Maps generic data types to TR181 specific types.

methods.name: tr181ErrorCode_t getErrorCode(WDMP_STATUS status)
methods.description: Converts WDMP status codes to TR181 error codes.

methods.name: tr181ErrorCode_t getParam(char * pcCallerID,const char * pcParameterName,TR181_ParamData_t * pstParamData)
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value via RFC call and populates the parameter data structure.

methods.name: tr181ErrorCode_t setParam(char * pcCallerID,const char * pcParameterName,const char * pcParameterValue)
methods.description: Sets a parameter value via RFC.

methods.name: tr181ErrorCode_t clearParam(char * pcCallerID,const char * pcParameterName)
methods.description: Clears a parameter by setting a special parameter to the target parameter name.

methods.name: const char * getTR181ErrorString(tr181ErrorCode_t code)
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string for a TR181 error code.

methods.name: tr181ErrorCode_t getValue(const char * fileName,const char * pcParameterName,TR181_ParamData_t * pstParam)
methods.description: Reads a parameter's value from a specified file, typically used for default or persistent storage.

methods.name: tr181ErrorCode_t getDefaultValue(char * pcCallerID,const char * pcParameterName,TR181_ParamData_t * pstParamData)
methods.description: Fetches the default value for a parameter from an associated .ini file.

methods.name: tr181ErrorCode_t setValue(const char * pcParameterName,const char * pcParamValue)
methods.description: Updates the local store file with a new parameter value, handling special clear parameter logic and thread safety.

methods.name: tr181ErrorCode_t getLocalParam(char * pcCallerID,const char * pcParameterName,TR181_ParamData_t * pstParamData)
methods.description: Safely retrieves a local parameter value with semaphore locking, falling back to default if not found.

methods.name: tr181ErrorCode_t setLocalParam(char * pcCallerID,const char * pcParameterName,const char * pcParameterValue)
methods.description: Safely sets a local parameter value with semaphore locking.

methods.name: tr181ErrorCode_t clearLocalParam(char * pcCallerID,const char * pcParameterName)
methods.description: Safely clears a local parameter with semaphore locking.

ctags.name: getValue
ctags.pattern: /^tr181ErrorCode_t getValue(const char* fileName, const char* pcParameterName, TR181_ParamData_t */

ctags.pattern: /^tr181ErrorCode_t setLocalParam(char *pcCallerID, const char* pcParameterName, const char* pcPara/

ctags.name: setParam
ctags.pattern: /^tr181ErrorCode_t setParam(char *pcCallerID, const char* pcParameterName, const char* pcParameter/

ctags.pattern: /^tr181ErrorCode_t setValue(const char* pcParameterName, const char* pcParamValue)$/
